summary: E2E tested Titip Mobil consignment flow on Next.js Mitra.Mobil app: home nav → form submit (sewa & label toggle for jual) → success panel → pending NOT in catalog → admin login → nav consignments (badge shown when pending>0) → approve → status Disetujui → approved titipan tampil di katalog dengan badge 'Titip Sewa' → detail page reachable (200). Rejected seed data verified NOT visible in Beli/Sewa catalog. Backend API checks (GET /api/consignments, /cars/<id>) return correct 200/404. All 9 tasks in review request pass end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: app/admin/page.tsx is large (680+ lines); consider splitting into sections (Dashboard, Consignments, etc.) for maintainability.

Prototype uses file-based JSON storage /app/data/consignments.json which is not concurrency-safe; document explicitly this is only a prototype and add a file lock or move to MongoDB before production.
GET /api/consignments (public) is called on every home page load and merges consignments client-side; add caching headers or ISR to reduce disk reads.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test created 1 pending -> approved consignment (Toyota TESTX-pxgth4, id titip-muhm9g1o-057ny) via UI. Also existing seeded: approved Daihatsu Xenia R (titip-muhm4t2y-kusum) and rejected Honda Brio Satya (titip-muhm4t6z-lcyv6).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App runs via 'yarn dev' on port 3000 (not supervisor). Data stored in /app/data/consignments.json. Admin login at /admin/login. Filter 'Mobil Bekas' + tab 'Sewa Mobil'/'Beli Mobil' needed to see titipan cars. All data-testid attributes are correctly wired: titip-mobil-menu-link, kind-sewa-button, kind-jual-button, input-*, consign-submit-button, consign-success, admin-nav-consignments, consign-pending-badge, consign-admin-list, approve-<id>, reject-<id>, consign-status-<id>.
